text: Astronomy is the study of the universe, consisting of celestial bodies such as stars, planets, moons, and other celestial objects. Craters are formed by meteor impacts, volcanic eruptions, and other geological processes. They are used to study the history of the universe and the evolution of celestial objects. Orbits are the paths that celestial bodies follow, including planets around the sun, and the moon orbiting Earth. The sun is the center of the solar system, and planets orbit around it in a circular or elliptical path. The moon orbits around Earth, and it has its own gravity that keeps it in orbit. The study of astronomy has led to many discoveries about the universe, including the discovery of planets beyond Earth, the formation of galaxies, and the evolution of the universe itself.
